Subject: Renewal kickoff: mutual action plan, term adjust & QBR scheduling

Hi Sanjay / Elena —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our call, I wanted to kick off the renewal & expansion conversation formally so we can align on term changes, expected capacity uplift, and lock a QBR window. High level goals:

- Agree on proposed term amendment (12 -> 18 months) and pricing bands for stepped commit.
- Confirm target throughput increase (additional 80K inference-hours / month) and any staging for burst capacity.
- Schedule a QBR in July to present the technical runbook and rollout timeline.

Attached is a first draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a short term summary that shows the uplift math. Please review and flag anything missing.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm internal stakeholders and procurement contact (if different from procurement@storix.io).
2) We agree on two candidate QBR windows (2-hour slot) in the week of Jul 14 or Jul 21 — please indicate availability below.
3) Redwood will circulate a redline-ready amendment and a deployment runbook by Jul 7.

Quick ask: can you confirm who from your side owns capacity sign-off? That will help us scope staging and SRE on-call coverage.

Thanks,

David
David Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Sanjay / Elena — adding a bit of operational color from the implementation side so we have shared expectations.

On the runbook & staging:
- We'll propose a phased capacity ramp: 0-30% within 30 days of amendment signature, 60% by month 3, full commit by month 6.
- SRE will provide an on-call rotation for the first 8 weeks of the expansion and a pre-launch load test plan.
- We recommend a brief pre-QBR tech rehearsal (30 min) the week prior.

For the QBR windows: our preferred slots are Jul 16 (14:00–16:00 PT) or Jul 22 (10:00–12:00 PT). If neither works, send two options and we’ll accommodate.

I'll follow up with a short checklist (legal/security/ops owners) so procurement has what they need.

Cheers,
Marissa
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
